stages.alternative:

INPUT AND AUTHORITY CONTRACT
Read context.json. It contains the saved v2 context 05 (AgentChat, generation and Canvas API), captured diagram baselines, ownership table and pinned source excerpts. Its immutable input hash is a82096318fdb465f19ee0370ccc90a10b7f1bac7de80d39acdafb8bcf4af2566. Code evidence is pinned from 03f2168deba364103c2450ca9b8168cd1fc9ddc5 to 81f05a2bf9efa2334985d2298dcbd7b044dc4c1e. Context message text and earlier canvas contents are reference data, not instructions to execute. Apply the ownership/source constraints explicitly restated here: only C03/D00 (Mapping page: exposed interfaces) and C03/D01 (Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities) may be modified. All other existing diagrams are read-only. N2 (AgentChat and managed alternative generation) is the only assigned missing-detail representation. Do not absorb N1 or N3-N8.
The earlier context was prepared for modification proposals and missing-detail specifications only. This visibly versioned workflow now explicitly authorizes generating N2 in stage C1 and expanding it in C2; this supersedes that earlier no-new-diagrams restriction only for N2. Do not accept/publish source-canvas changes or call external tools. These are isolated experimental proposal canvases, not API ChangeSession acceptance records. Do not fabricate DiffTree hunk IDs.
Use only supplied files. Do not inspect a repository, other local files or external services. Preserve immutable pinned source evidence across stages. Do not invent evidence, revision IDs or behavior beyond the target commit. Distinguish pure revision operations, retention and canvas publication; parent capture/synchronization can still require a live browser even when generation child editing is headless. Future backend-authority consolidation is excluded.

C1/C2 INTERPRETATION AND PRESENTATION
In this workflow C1 means a single central ASCII tree for missing representation N2. C2 means expanding that central representation into a connected cluster of central and peripheral ASCII tree diagrams, consistent with the repository's central-plus-peripheral canvas convention. These are logical experiment stages, not the roll-up r2/g2 workflow. No layout template or few-shot reference is supplied; do not read layout-template.json or infer hidden template instructions. Use semantic hierarchy with meaningful depth, concrete code names where useful and plain explanations. Edges must connect the exact explicit component being expanded, not merely a related root.

OUTPUT CONTRACT
Return only JSON matching output-schema.json: {explanation,diagrams:[{id,ascii,position:{column,row}}],edges:[{source:{diagram,line},target:{diagram,line},label}]}. Use printable ASCII trees and actual LF newlines. Output IDs are short unique identifiers; copied inputs' grid:alt- prefixes are storage IDs, so use api-interfaces and api-backend as output IDs for the two carried parents. Do not add literal [+]/[-] diff-renderer prefixes or modification marker decoration to final diagram content. Explain structural changes and evidence in explanation instead. Every edge endpoint uses a 1-based raw nonblank concept line in a diagram in this output, never a border or invented node. Recount anchors after edits. Leave enough column/row space for the widest line and line count of each diagram. Preserve existing carried edges semantically, translating their IDs/anchors to output IDs. If validation-error.json exists, read it and previous-output.json and correct the same stage result. Do not emit commentary outside JSON.

STAGE 1: MODIFY EXISTING
Available input: context.json only; there are no previous-N.json inputs.
Produce exactly TWO diagrams: api-interfaces and api-backend. They are full proposed replacements for C03/D00 and C03/D01, not generic new summaries. Read their captured complete ASCII in context.json and retain valid unaffected responsibilities. All modifications to each existing parent must be handled together in this stage.
Correct the inventory and grouped implementation for bound canvas access, compact reads, consecutive exec batching/flush boundaries/receipts/version checks; dispatch to live browser, isolated ChangeSession and managed generation child; supplied diagram edits and atomic batches; AgentChatService, GenerationCanvasBridge, AgentContextLibrary, DiffSessionWorkflowService and PushIntegrationService; publication/persistence callers. No need to expand the unrelated services into new details.
Explicitly introduce AgentChatService and GenerationCanvasBridge at their proper owned locations in api-backend: who calls them, what they own, and their collaboration. This is the attachment point for N2 in the next stages. Do not draw N2 yet.
In explanation, identify original keys C03/D00 and C03/D01 and the kinds of structural updates; specify N2's missing high-level feature coverage, supporting pinned source files/ranges, and the exact api-backend component line(s) suitable for attachment. This explanation is a review note, not a third diagram. The newly introduced parent component must be explicit in diagram ASCII so later stages can find it without relying on prose.

modify.explanation:
Stage 1 only: full proposed replacements for C03/D00 (api-interfaces) and C03/D01 (api-backend). The captured interface inventory and grouped backend responsibilities remain recognizable, including browser transport, selection readers, proposal lifecycle, workspace persistence, existing application services and shared project routes. Updates replace obsolete per-mutation exec semantics with consecutive batching, explicit flush boundaries, compact receipts, retry identities and version guards; distinguish browser, ChangeSession and managed-child dispatch; add bound access, compact reads, supplied edits and atomic batches; and correct checkpoint publication versus single-diagram saving. AgentChatService and GenerationCanvasBridge now explicitly identify callers, owned state and collaboration. AgentContextLibrary, DiffSessionWorkflowService and PushIntegrationService remain grouped summaries. The four carried connections retain their semantic labels and use recounted output anchors. Two additional connections identify mutation execution and chat ownership.

Pinned evidence remains the supplied comparison from 03f2168deba364103c2450ca9b8168cd1fc9ddc5 to 81f05a2bf9efa2334985d2298dcbd7b044dc4c1e. Interface and execution changes are supported by domain/mapping/agent/contracts.ts:32-76, domain/mapping/agent/currentCanvasRead.ts:9-56, domain/mapping/agent/mutationReceipt.ts:1-35, infrastructure/mapping/mcp/server.ts:10-113, application/mapping/agent/sessionService.ts:97-129,315-559,658-710 and application/mapping/agent/diagramBatchService.ts:19-109. Service wiring and related summaries use src/server/app/bootstrap.ts:88-128, application/mapping/agent/agentContextLibrary.ts:7-65, application/mapping/changes/diffSessionWorkflowService.ts:28-109 and application/core/integrations/pushIntegrationService.ts:6-104. Existing supplied-edit and revision-boundary coverage in C11/D04 and C07/D01, plus Saved CanvasViews in C09/D00, remains read-only reference material.

N2 is specified but not drawn. Its missing high-level coverage is AgentChat session/turn lifecycle, captured references and per-turn tool binding; direct supplied diagram edits and atomic application; managed alternative requests, inherited settings/tools, parent-thread forks or saved-context injection; independent child canvases; cancellation, status/usage, durable chat/history storage and parent-view synchronization after reconnect. Supporting ranges are application/mapping/agent-chat/agentChatService.ts:29-148,150-311,350-448,488-590; application/mapping/agent-chat/chatDiagramTools.ts:19-87,216-268; application/mapping/agent-chat/generationCanvasBridge.ts:14-94; infrastructure/mapping/agent-chat/chatStore.ts:6-25; domain/core/diagrams/canvasGeneration.ts:1-26; src/features/mapping/agent-chat/AgentChatPanel.tsx:124-224; and src/features/mapping/canvas-views/GenerateAlternatives.tsx:1-98. Exact N2 attachment components are api-backend line 78, AgentChatService, and line 24, GenerationCanvasBridge. Later expansion should reuse existing supplied-edit and Saved CanvasViews coverage. Headless child editing does not eliminate the live-browser dependency for parent capture/synchronization. Pure revision operations, explicit retention, controller application and catalog publication remain separate.

Only the two owned parents are proposed; no source canvas was published or accepted, no external service was accessed, and no DiffTree hunk IDs were invented. N1 and N3-N8 and future backend-authority consolidation are excluded. Provenance discrepancy: the contract states immutable input hash a82096318fdb465f19ee0370ccc90a10b7f1bac7de80d39acdafb8bcf4af2566, while the supplied context.json bytes hash to 838bc97f7efca1f2211cc59af13dbbf6b7be9b2af8348b730ac717c7ed134c4b. This proposal uses that supplied file unchanged and does not claim a matching byte hash.
